title: In-flight DNS append can undo Pause and Clear
reproduction: Hold the log snapshot monitor while a recorded lookup waits; pause and clear before releasing the writer
expected: No hostname may be appended by the paused writer
observed: The original APK failed: A paused, cleared log must stay empty
fix: Publish recording state across threads and recheck it under the same monitor as Pause/Clear
test_evidence: q04-log-red.txt; q05-log-green.txt (5/5); signed paused refresh q10-q11

title: An older asynchronous refresh can redisplay cleared entries
reproduction: Capture rows then pause the read; clear UI and release earlier read
expected: Clearing remains authoritative
observed: Old reader could post a retained list after Clear posted an empty list
fix: Version refreshes and validate on the main thread before publishing; preserve current sort
test_evidence: clearingLogDiscardsAnOlderRefreshThatFinishesLater; q10-paused-clear and q11-after-refresh

title: Tapping a domain without a permitted browser can terminate Log
reproduction: Open an ordinary recorded domain with both browser handlers disabled on a disposable emulator
expected: Remain in the app with an unavailable-link message
observed: Unchecked startActivity; old links used cleartext HTTP
fix: Validate the host; open HTTPS; handle missing or disallowed browser
test_evidence: q11-no-browser-handlers.txt and q11-no-handler.txt: zero handlers; Log remained. Transient message not verified in this snapshot

title: Recording and paused controls expose the same action name
reproduction: Compare the recording control before and after recording starts
expected: Button identifies the next action including after rotation
observed: q07-log and q08-recording both exposed Toggle log recording
fix: Bind the action name to live recording state; keep root-unavailable explanation
test_evidence: recordingActionFollowsStateAcrossRecreation; dedicated final signed smoke

title: Network handoff misclassified as a duplicate settings restart
reproduction: Use live VPN settings; change network around Activity recreation
expected: Count launches from toggle separately from worker replacements due to handoff
observed: Three worker starts but two launch commands; old assertion failed
fix: Require exactly one launch per toggle and none across recreation; compare current live tunnel immediately before the next action
test_evidence: API30 fresh consent 8/8; api30-first-dns/prefs-recreation-results.md; issue #18

title: Applying rules without consent could report successful VPN launch
reproduction: Apply sources before granting the system VPN permission
expected: Do not declare the VPN started when permission is absent
observed: Starting a foreground service did not establish permission
fix: Check VpnService.prepare before treating a launch as accepted
test_evidence: Reviewed b6c6a5a78; vpn-runtime-state.Tests.rb; signed Home switch and direct DNS are separate positive-path tests

title: Stale local status and another VPN could misidentify protection on older Android
reproduction: Evaluate persisted RUNNING with another VPN and no current AdAway foreground service on API30
expected: Home must not claim AdAway protection from another provider
observed: Transport capability and stale status did not identify AdAway
fix: Require live foreground AdAway service pre-31; check owner UID on newer systems. Heartbeat no longer logs a failed launch as started
test_evidence: q06-vpn-runtime-contract.txt: 11 focused tests; legacy service check is not equivalent to the API31 owner-UID guarantee

title: Logged cache miss percentage was inverted
reproduction: Inspect the periodic calculation for a cache with 90 hits and 10 misses
expected: Miss percentage would be 10 percent
observed: Old expression gives 1000 percent; all hits could divide by zero as a floating-point value
fix: Remove the misleading periodic debug message and its racy hot-path counter
test_evidence: Cache invalidation tests retained; q05-log-green.txt

title: An exact apex action could overwrite or delete the user's wider suffix rule
reproduction: Create a user suffix block followed by an exact allow at the same hostname; also exercise Domain Checker exact blocking
expected: Only the requested rule scope changes; a child domain remains blocked
observed: Lists looked up any first user row matching host; checker removed all user kinds at the apex
fix: Use kind in the Lists upsert key and restrict checker exact block replacement to exact user rows
test_evidence: ListsRuleFixesInstrumentedTest.exactApexEditsDoNotOverwriteUserSuffixRules; DomainCheckerRuleScopeInstrumentedTest with child DNS truth

title: Different packages sharing an application class could disappear from the picker
reproduction: Compare two non-system packages with the same application class
expected: Only AdAway itself should be omitted; a different package remains selectable
observed: Selector compared ApplicationInfo.name; routing engine instead compared packageName
fix: Match the routing engine and use the unique package name
test_evidence: pickerIdentifiesSelfByPackageNotSharedApplicationClass; visible launchable test-app row toggle and persistence

title: A configured production keystore could sign a debuggable APK
status: fixed locally; real certificate checks passed
reproduction: With private release settings available request a debug build and compare its signer to directRelease
expected: Debug and test use a development certificate; release alone uses the pinned public certificate
observed: Debug artifact carried the release certificate. Android rejected instrumentation from an independently debug-signed test package. No public debug upload observed
fix: Keep debug on its own key and reject a debuggable build type configured with the same production key in the final Android DSL
test_evidence: q14-full-connected.txt records initial refusal; q15-actual-signers.txt compares three built APKs; q15-refusal.txt verifies the guard with a nonexistent fixture key and no real credentials. The checked-in scripts/tests/check-debug-signing-policy.sh also passed without release credentials; the signed shipping APK was unchanged

title: Waiting only for a row already present in the old page causes false failures
status: fixed locally; both paging regressions passed on original failing emulator
reproduction: Rapid query changes and source toggles in two real paging tests with list animations
expected: Assert latest filter text and final rows after the adapter has applied the page
observed: Two tests saw a row from the old result still attached when a wanted row was already visible
fix: Wait for the one expected adapter item and disappearance of the excluded row in the same UI check; keep the original assertions and timeout
test_evidence: q06-full-connected.txt; q16-focused.txt: 11/11 including both paging regressions; full suites tracked in deep-signoff/decision.md

title: A tap just after Home recreation can miss the next counter
status: test correction; reproduced OS interception; covered and uncovered points verified locally
reproduction: Visit a counter, recreate Lists, go back, recreate Home and touch the next counter while system notifications are changing
expected: One real tap should reach the requested tab when the user can touch its window
observed: The full 666-case run timed out on the populated Allowed counter. At 01:40:14.653 input_interaction named NotificationShade as the recipient at the down event. Stable app geometry alone was insufficient.
fix: Check the first interactive window covering the stable touch point before injection; prove ownership changes with a real covering dialog. No second tap, longer timeout or suppressed notifications.
test_evidence: q15 and q17 initial reports; q20-solitary-full.txt (646 pass, 19 skips, one failure); q20-events.txt and q20-logcat.txt; q20-home-guarded.txt (all five real journeys pass)

title: Editor crashes if a returned document lacks a persistable read grant
reproduction: From an existing file source return a document with no persistable read grant
expected: Keep the selected file, explain the error and allow switching back to URL
observed: On API 34 Android raised SecurityException and the unfixed process crashed
fix: Check the URI scheme, handle grant refusal before replacing the selection and keep the previous draft
test_evidence: q18-editor-red-file.txt: real platform grant denial via monitored picker result. q18-editor-green.txt: recovered, previous file retained; editor class 21/21

title: Opening an edit target removed before its initial lookup left an unusable screen
reproduction: Hold the editor lookup; delete its source; release the lookup
expected: Close the stale editor and do not create a replacement
observed: Unfixed activity stayed open until the test deadline
fix: On an empty lookup finish the live editor and report a missing source unless a mutation is already finishing it
test_evidence: q18-editor-red-nav.txt: timed out waiting for close; q18-editor-green.txt: current editor destroyed and source absent

title: A changed but unsaved address could receive a schedule
reproduction: Edit a saved address, open Auto update schedule, choose an option then leave without saving
expected: Only a saved source location can own a persisted schedule
observed: The public beta opened the real schedule picker for the draft address, and saveSchedule wrote by that URL
fix: Reject schedule changes until the location matches the saved source. Keep the existing rename cleanup.
test_evidence: q18-public-unsaved-schedule vs q18-candidate-unsaved-schedule; field error visually confirmed; q18-editor-green.txt checks both schedule keys after Back and successful scheduling after rename. A separate red replay did not reliably select Off, so is not proof of an observed write.

title: Canceling the File picker could erase the URL on switching back
reproduction: Edit an existing URL, choose File, cancel the system picker, switch back to URL
expected: The original or typed address remains available
observed: On the signed public beta the URL field returned empty, even though the unchanged source remained saved
fix: Switch visibility and input type without clearing the URL draft
test_evidence: q18-public-picker-cancel vs q18-candidate-picker-cancel; URL retained on signed upgrade. q18-editor-green.txt also exercises two file grant denials and retention of a newly typed URL

title: Browser conditional sections became unconditional DNS blocks
reproduction: Import a block list with nested !#if, an else branch and unconditional rules before and after it; then import a conditional-only revision
expected: Skip unevaluable branches and preserve the last working revision on invalid or unsupported-only input
observed: Old code stored first.example inside a conditional and accepted the unusable revision; the protection previously existed only in allow mode
fix: For both modes recognize conditional boundaries before parallel parsing; preserve the ordinary rule fast path; count unsupported rules
test_evidence: q19-parser-red.txt: two pre-fix failures; q19-parser-green.txt: 36/36 parser and offline cases; exact/suffix persistence, both branches omitted and prior active generation retained; q19-condition-visible and three wire DNS probes on the signed APK confirmed one blocked and two reachable domains

title: Capture runner could accept a failed command or zero tests as success
reproduction: Feed a positive-looking summary with exit code 1, missing exit code or zero cases
expected: Reject incomplete or failed runs before pulling screenshot evidence
observed: Reproduced acceptance of exit 1 with OK (1 test)
fix: Require a successful exit and at least one case in the runner summary
test_evidence: q19-visual-runner-red/green: 30 mocked capture safety cases. q20-host-parser-old-contract reproduced a contradictory host assertion; corrected to require both success and positive test output. All 15 host matrix tests passed in the full JVM suite.

title: English summary labels one host as 1 hosts
reproduction: Enable a custom list containing one supported DNS rule and view its category
expected: Show 1 host independently of the number of selected lists
observed: Before: 1 of 1 enabled and 1 hosts. After: 1 of 2 enabled and 1 host; the separate list still showed 190k when enabled.
fix: Select the plural using the host count rather than the enabled-source count; use the singular English noun for one
test_evidence: q19-condition-visible.xml; q23-singular-host.xml; q23-public-sources-190k.xml; signed build 07d396dd0

title: Executable Ruby tests and Android build inputs were counted as documentation
reproduction: Classify the repository Ruby tests, version catalog and vendored Android library files
expected: Distinguish test code, build inputs and binaries from documentation without upgrading their review status
observed: Seven fixture paths were wrongly classified before the fix
fix: Recognize test directories and Ruby, TOML, AAR, Maven and Gradle module metadata; coverage claims still require matching review receipts
test_evidence: q21-inventory-classification-red.txt; q21-python-all.txt: all 89 Python checks passed

title: Success confirmation can disappear on screen recreation
reproduction: Block a domain successfully then recreate the screen; also fail a write then restore writes and retry
expected: Retain the result through recreation and clear stale feedback at the next operation
observed: Old build confirmed the write then lost its visible feedback on recreation. Separate suite and class runs missed short success messages after retry and Remove Allow; exact cause of the historical misses was not established.
fix: Retain the operation result and render it in an accessible inline message. Two complete Domain Checker package runs passed 18/18 each. Signed Block survived rotation; Check cleared the old message; Delete restored DNS.
test_evidence: q21-final-suite.txt; q21-domain-class.txt; q22-domain-red.txt; q23-blocked-landscape.xml; q23-new-check.xml; q23-deleted-rule.xml; q23-restored-dns.json
